newsitem.title: USA: Oil dealers in NE U.S. see no evidence of hoarding.
newsitem.headline: Oil dealers in NE U.S. see no evidence of hoarding.

text.p: In the latest worrying sign that heating costs could soar this winter, heating oil dealers in the key northeastern U.S. market said Thursday that they have seen no evidence of wholesale or end-customer hoarding.

Their comments run counter to the theory put forward by some industry analysts that historically low refiner inventories of heating oil probaly could be explained by hoarding at the distribution and retail level.
